tagline: The book lives in the app. Invite a friend onto the same page — nothing is uploaded.
description:
Open an EPUB and it lives inside the app. Close it, come back, you are still on the same page. It never leaves this device — not to a server, not when you send an invite.

Press Invite in the bar above and a friend lands on the page you are reading. Turn a page, they turn. Press Point, then hold a line, and a pointer appears on theirs. The file itself is not sent to a website; they are looking at the same copy, on their own device, even on a plane.

Swipe to turn pages on a phone. Contents lists every chapter. A− / A+ change the type. Find jumps to every match in the chapter.

A short public-domain book is already open the first time, so you can try it before you pick a file of your own.

The engine is FuturePress's epub.js, packed in. Unofficial — FuturePress did not bless this copy.
